$comment: Schema v2, the live schema extract.py validates against. x-filled-by says who writes each field: llm = the extraction prompts, code = extract.py, tagger = the two tagging calls assembled by code, enricher = enricher/enrich.py, external = populated after extraction outside the LLM, none = left empty. See docs/schema_v2.md.
title: ProviderDocument

source_file.description: Name of the crawled Markdown file this record was extracted from.

extracted_by_model.description: SOCLAAS model that extracted this record: one of MODEL_POOL in classifier_extractor/llm_pool.py.

name.description: Left empty (null): not generated, to save tokens. The real name is anonymised away on purpose and is never taken from the source.

title.description: Job title for the profile card, 2-8 words, plain and factual (e.g. "Forensic Accountant"). Not a sales hook.

credentials.description: Professional registrations, certifications and memberships the source states, one per item (e.g. "Certified Public Accountant (CPA)"). Empty list when the source states none; never a degree-free guess and never a sentence about the source.

years_experience.description: Years in the individual's field. The tenure the source states; else the years of their roles added up as of 2026, rounded down; else null. Never estimated from seniority or titles.

about_headline.description: One-line headline, at most 20 words, in the title style rolled for this record.

about_bio.description: Bio, 70-100 words: specialisation, past roles described generically (no employer, client or person names), and the Singapore setting. First person or implied, per the voice rolled for this record.

services.description: Services the individual offers, best fit first. Each is ONE engagement a single client could hire them for alone.

service_title.description: Name of the service, 3-10 words (e.g. "Construction Claims Preparation and Dispute Advisory").

service_detail.description: 40-65 words: who it is for (small and mid-sized Singapore businesses where the expertise suits them), "Services include ..." with 3-5 concrete services, optionally the Singapore laws and standards that govern it, and optionally one scope-limit sentence.

achievements.description: Specific outcomes the individual personally produced, one sentence each, keeping every figure the source gives. Never a job title, responsibility, degree, certification, publication or tenure statement. Empty list when the source has no outcome-level content.

technical_proficiency.description: Tools, methods and standards the source names, grouped. Free text taken from the source (e.g. SAP S/4HANA, IFRS 16); not the SkillsFuture skills in tags.

skills.description: Skills, tools or standards in this group, one per item.

how_i_work.description: 25-60 words, first person: how the individual runs an engagement. Written in the style pass and not source-backed, so it may describe an approach but must add no credential, client, figure or claim of experience.

availability.description: Free text, e.g. "Available from November 2026, 2 days a week."

rate.description: Free text, in S$, e.g. "From S$3,000 per day."

tags.description: SkillsFuture tags, nested category -> specialisation -> skills. Assembled by code from two flat model replies and validated against data/reference/skillsfuture/, so every name is a real sector, track or skill. Empty categories list when nothing fits.

group.description: Which heading the platform's Category list shows this category under. Left null by the extractor; populated afterwards from the platform's own category list, never by the LLM.

name.description: A SkillsFuture track listed under this sector.

skills.description: SkillsFuture TSC titles linked to this track. May be empty.
